blocks.text: Our first in the series of holiday gift guides is for fitness! Historically, the holidays are marked with libations and cheat days. Apart from gifting gym memberships, here are some wearables and tech accessories that can help you track your health and nerd out on the gym floor. We asked the Tech.INQ staff to pick out their recommendations for the holidays.

The latest series of the Apple Watch may be overshadowed with the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max alongside the iPhone Duo later this year. However, we definitely should not sleep on the new Watch because it sports brand new tracking hardware that was never present in any series before.

From the front, the new Apple Watch 12 doesn’t seem like it has anything new. But if you flip it around, you’ll see that it has twice the number of sensors, from the previous four bumped up to eight green sensors so that it can ping your heart rate every 5 seconds. This is very useful for people who are consciously tracking their heart rate or refuse to wear a smart ring.
The Apple Watch Series 12 also comes with a new ceramic version that has a bit more heft starting at P65,990.

Momax has combined hydration with music. The Momax 1-vibe bottle is a water bottle, magsafe holder, and TWS speaker all in one. This is a minimalist approach to working out at the gym, especially if you’re the type that wants to film yourself or have full view of your smartphone’s controls without putting it down. Momax is also a decent audio brand with IPX7 waterproofing for the bottle lid, which is also the speaker. The bottle holds 750ml of liquid in its double-wall receptacle.

If you’re looking for credible and affordable smart watches, HiFuture’s Lume Pro has a battery life good to go for one week. This beats out many other contenders in the space in terms of price as other watches from Garmin and TREX can cost upwards of P12,000 pesos. This is a fraction of the price. The Lume Pro comes with a 1.85″ square AMOLED display, health monitoring, and 100+ sports modes.

If you’re looking for a more traditional round smart watch face, the CURVE2 from Weofly might be another good option for yourself or as a gift. The watch itself is rated for 3ATM waterproof, sleep monitoring, 1.43″ AMOLED (round) display, and at least 5 days of battery life.
